{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Probus Tesla]] owned and wore a '''taozin-scale necklace''' made from [[Synthsilk/Legends|synthsilk]]. Though there wasn't enough [[Taozin/Legends|taozin]] scale on the [[Taozin amulet|necklace]] to completely shield Probus Tesla's presence in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] from other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], it was enough to scramble any emanations that might leak out of him, rendering him unreadable. Meaning that Force-sensitives would have to work awfully hard to get a fix on him. Following his second [[Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row|battle]] with [[Kajin Savaros]] at [[Rainbow Parkway]], Tesla lost it in the wreckage of an apothecary he was buried under. He escaped without the taozin. Following the battle [[Jax Pavan]] and his friends decided to relocate given the battle was close to their residence. [[Laranth Tarak]] moved Kajin to [[Thi Xon Yimmon|Thi Xon Yimmon's]] home at a gallery and ordered mudlarps, waifs who lived by pilfering meaning they wouldn't draw attention, to retrieve the taozin for Kajin to shield his unnatural and immense power in the Force from other Force adepts. Though if Kajin was to have a Force tantarum it wouldn't shield him from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], but Laranth was satisfied with it until they could move [[Ves Volette|Ves Volette's]] Force damping [[light sculptures]] to Kajin's new home. On the way to Yimmon, Laranth and Kajin were trapped and exposed to with spice gas, leaving them unconscious. Before loosing consciousness, however, Kajin ripped off the taozin, breaking the chain, and dropped it on the floor to give Jax a sign as to where he had been. Yimmon sent out search teams after Laranth and Kajin failed to show, and soon found the taozin which Yimmon showed Jax over hologram. [[Dejah Duare]] asked if Jax had any skill in [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometry]], because, as a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]], she could sense something about it. Jax told her he had some skill but rarely used it and made his way over to use the ability on the taozin.<ref name="CNIII:POF">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
